name: 豆包电脑版
desc: Desktop build of ByteDance's Doubao assistant.
desc_zh: 字节跳动豆包助手的电脑版
solves: A phone-only assistant cannot see the file you have open. The desktop build reads the window in front of you.
solves_zh: 只在手机上的助手看不见你正打开的文件。电脑版读得到你眼前的窗口。
best_for: You want Doubao to work against the files and windows on your computer.
best_for_zh: 你想让豆包针对你电脑上的文件和窗口干活。
